name: scope HUD opens on a single glowing word
looks: A pitch-black frame carries a thin instrument HUD (small mono labels, a flat scanline) along its edges. A short word snaps onto the centre in a thin green outline font with no entrance easing, holds, then hard-cuts to a second short phrase and a third, each replacing the last with no crossfade, the baseline scanline flexing slightly under each new phrase.
build: DOM word swapped on hard beats (no easing) inside a fixed HUD frame (corner labels, a small changing section tag top-right, a scanline strip along the bottom riding a looping noise waveform). Mono/outline display font, single accent green on black.
sound: A low synth drone under the HUD, a soft blip exactly as each phrase cuts in.
prompt: Open cold on a near-black frame dressed like a diagnostic instrument: thin corner marks, a small running label, a flat scanline along one edge. A short word or phrase hard-cuts onto the centre in a thin monochrome outline face, holds a beat, then is replaced by the next phrase with no easing or crossfade, so the opening reads as a machine coming online and stating its purpose one word at a time.
